description: Block Diffusion for Flash Speculative Decoding — cross-framework inference acceleration (vLLM/SGLang/Transformers/MLX)
notes: 推测性解码加速框架，跨四大推理框架(vLLM/SGLang/Transformers/MLX)+跨平台(NVIDIA/Apple M)。1.8~2.3倍吞吐量提升。已有HF草稿模型：Qwen3.6-27B-DFlash(261⭐)、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-DFlash(214⭐)、gemma-4-31B-it-DFlash(52⭐)。与Google Gemma 4专用草稿模型(939MB→3倍)形成路线对比：DFlash通用框架vs Google专用小模型
